data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Hajraa means 'The One Who Migrated'. This name carries the spiritual significance of being steadfast in one's faith and journeying towards a better future, just like the Prophet Hajar who migrated to the desert with her son Ibrahim. The name Hajraa carries the meaning “The One Who Migrated” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hajraa usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who migrated and live with faith, good character and purpose.
